workItem: Repair the Post-Merge Production Correlation observer after the canonical Render deployment migration to the exact-commit API trigger, and make final correlation evidence reflect converged Production state without creating a second deployment authority.
workItemDE: Den Post-Merge-Production-Correlation-Observer nach der kanonischen Render-Migration auf den Exact-Commit-API-Trigger korrigieren und finale Correlation-Evidence auf den konvergierten Production-Zustand beziehen, ohne eine zweite Deployment-Authority zu erzeugen.
priorityReason: Issue #1464 reports false PRODUCTION_DRIFT because the observer still searches the retired deploy-hook step name after PR #1463 renamed the canonical CI trigger to the Render API step.
scopeBoundary: Correlation/evidence repair only; do not trigger GitHub Actions, Render deployment, recovery, or provider mutation.
Keep .github/workflows/ci.yml as the sole GitHub-to-Render deployment lane and Render native auto-deploy off.
Do not change mergeCadence.mjs cadence authority or the exact-commit Render API trigger implementation.
Preserve least privilege, immutable pinned actions, branch-only mutation, and Human/CODEOWNER merge.
exitEvidence: Correlation observer matches the current canonical CI deployment step name used after PR #1463.
Regression test cross-checks the producer CI workflow and observer contract so a future step rename cannot silently create NOT_OBSERVED evidence.

When Production converges to CURRENT_MAIN during polling, reported relation/progress/remaining values reflect the final readback while the originally-due boundary still requires observed trigger evidence.
No Render/provider mutation or second recovery/deployment controller is introduced.
Exact-head required checks remain for the Pull Request; Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue #1464 false-negative root cause is removed.
Due deployments still fail closed when the canonical API trigger step is genuinely not observed.
Exact Production convergence reports CURRENT_MAIN rather than stale ANCESTOR evidence.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
